description: R-OLEDB-1 fixture (MDB), created by DBEngine.CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, 64) and the closed file kept: Items (AutoNumber key, unique Code, Long, Double, Currency, Decimal added by CreateField type 20, Date/Time, Text(50), Memo, Long Binary, Binary(16), Yes/No, Integer, Byte, Single, GUID; a table Description property) with five rows (full, Null, empty text/binary, long memo and binary values with extremes, 50-character text and ten-byte binary); Seq (32 rows); Child with a foreign key to Items; Req with a required column and, through ADO, a CHECK constraint; saved queries QParam, QMulti (five parameters declared in a different order from their use), QAction, QEmpty and QSel; an index on (L DESC, D); and in ACCDB a table with WITH COMPRESSION columns made through ADO.

args.text: CREATE TABLE Items (ID COUNTER CONSTRAINT PK_Items PRIMARY KEY, Code TEXT(10) CONSTRAINT UX_Items_Code UNIQUE, L LONG, D DOUBLE, C CURRENCY, Dt DATETIME, Txt TEXT(50), M MEMO, B LONGBINARY, Bin BINARY(16), Y YESNO, Sh SHORT, Bt BYTE, Sg SINGLE, G GUID)
CREATE INDEX IX_Items_LD ON Items (L DESC, D)
CREATE TABLE Seq (ID COUNTER CONSTRAINT PK_Seq PRIMARY KEY, V LONG)
INSERT INTO Seq (V) SELECT V + 1 FROM Seq
INSERT INTO Seq (V) SELECT V + 1 FROM Seq
INSERT INTO Seq (V) SELECT V + 1 FROM Seq
INSERT INTO Seq (V) SELECT V + 1 FROM Seq
INSERT INTO Seq (V) SELECT V + 1 FROM Seq
CREATE TABLE Child (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_Child PRIMARY KEY, TID LONG CONSTRAINT FK_Child_Items REFERENCES Items (ID), [Note] TEXT(20))
CREATE TABLE Req (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_Req PRIMARY KEY, R TEXT(5) NOT NULL, V LONG)
PARAMETERS pCode Text(10); SELECT ID, Code, Txt FROM Items WHERE Code = pCode;
PARAMETERS pB Text(10), pA Long, pC Currency, pD DateTime, pY YesNo; SELECT ID, Code, L, C, Dt, Y FROM Items WHERE L = pA OR Code = pB OR C = pC OR Dt = pD OR Y = pY;
PARAMETERS pT Text(50), pId Long; UPDATE Items SET Txt = pT WHERE ID = pId;
SELECT ID, Code FROM Items ORDER BY ID;
ALTER TABLE Req ADD CONSTRAINT CK_Req_V CHECK (V >= 0)
